requirements.title: Associated data pointer definition status follows its target and definable target variable rules
requirements.definition: The definition status of an associated data pointer is that of its target. A pointer associated with a definable target becomes defined or undefined according to the variable rules of 19.6.

pending.associated-data-pointer-defined-target-v: Target integer t=42 is defined before p=>t; reading p into observed=-777 gives exact 42, and assigning p=77 changes t to exact 77.
pending.pointer-definition-through-definable-tar: Pointer p=>target t initialized to 1; assigning p=42 defines the target and a direct read of t gives exact 42, cross-referencing 19.6 for definition status.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.

requirements.title: Pointer definition status is undefined while not associated
requirements.definition: The definition status of a pointer that is not associated is undefined.

pending.not-associated-pointer-definition-status: No portable runtime oracle reads or otherwise observes definition status of a nonassociated pointer; the plan observes only ASSOCIATED(p)=.FALSE. under the owning association-status rule and never dereferences p.

requirements.oracle: Undefined definition status of a nonassociated pointer has no portable runtime oracle. Future fixtures may establish disassociation with ASSOCIATED false, but they must not read, write, compare, or otherwise inspect the pointer value as a definition-status observation.
